label: SMOKE fixture — Associated Press fact check (misleading element)
summary: AP said it was unclear which market measure Trump meant. The S&P 500 had reached a new record 64 times since the start of his second term, but 74 times since the 2024 election.
title: FACT FOCUS: Trump boasts about the economy but there's more to the story
nuance: Misleading or context-lacking element of the claim.
